title: Retrieval Augmented Question Answering: When Should LLMs Admit Ignorance?
authors: Dingmin Wang; Ji Ma; Shankar Kumar
why_relevant: Proposes iterative chunked prompting to mitigate distractor noise in long-context RAG, and explicitly analyzes LLMs' failure to abstain when evidence is insufficient, directly relevant to calibration/abstention under unreliable retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Method is relatively simple; abstention analysis is observational rather than a new technique.
suggested_section: Calibration and Abstention under Insufficient Evidence
